listing.name: Don't Repair This Ship
listing.summary: Adds a hullmod that prevents ships from being restored by the Hull Restoration skill.

description:
Hi everyone, I made a small mod that lets you prevent certain ships from being restored by the Hull Restoration skill.

What it does:

This mod adds a hullmod that makes a ship "unrestorable", meaning:

- D-mods will NOT be removed over time by Hull Restoration

- The ship behaves like special campaign ships (e.g. automated ships recovered from the Planetkiller mission)

Use cases:

- Prevent unwanted ships from being repaired, so Hull Restoration focuses on the ships you want.

- If you use Hull Restoration early on to save story points when recovering ships, you might want to keep D-mods later to benefit from Derelict Operations.

- If you use both Hull Restoration and Derelict Operations (may happen if you install

A New Level of Confidence

), this mod helps avoid the conflict — you can keep D-mods on capital ships for lower DP, while still letting Hull Restoration repair your smaller ships.

-

NOT
